4 melodies M45 (E minor, bass, 4/8), M46 (F# minor, 3/8), M47 (F minor, 16 bars, 3/4), M48 (D minor, bass, 4/4). OMR read every key as its relative major (G/A/Ab/F); spelling was already key-independent so pitches were right, keys corrected. OMR fixes: M45 bars 5-6 fake tuplets (\tuplet 3/2, 5/4) rewritten (E F# G. B / A B C16 B A), spurious staccato on B2 removed, 'cresc.' text added as markup, slurs split into 1-4 and 5-8; M46 dropped dots (bar 4 C#8., bar 8 G#8.), missing staccatos, dim/cres hairpins placed; M47 hairpins (cres 1-2, dim 3-4, cres 7-8, dim 11-12), slur E5-Eb5 bar 7-8 and tie F4 bars 15-16 added; M48 staccato on bar 9 D4, hairpins. lilylet hairpin bug: after one hairpin crosses a barline its carry state is never cleared, so a later cross-barline hairpin is cut at the end of its first bar and a ghost copy of the first hairpin is drawn to the later end; and \! always closes a cres, so it closes that stale one instead of an in-bar dim. Workaround: at most one cross-barline hairpin per melody; shortened ones: M47 cres bar 1 (orig. bars 1-2), dim bar 3 (orig. 3-4), dim bar 11 (orig. 11-12); M48 cres ends at the last note of bar 4 (orig. to the f in bar 5); M46 cres ends at the end of bar 7. M48 bar 8: second C# redraws its sharp (known repeated-accidental bug).
